title: On Depending on my uncle for everything
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：depend　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 depend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the engineer ① depended on my uncle for everything in silence, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the engineer ② depends on my uncle for everything twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ depend on my uncle for everything at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ depended on my uncle for everything before — a line in the manual for April 1970 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Depending on my uncle for everything in silence, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lever at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ depend on the weather alone twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Depend on the weather alone at once and never mention it again.

By 1983 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the manual, and a new worker from the next workshop ⑧ depends on the weather alone in silence every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ depended on my uncle for everything again when nobody else would.

⑩ To depend on my uncle for everything, my mother said in 1988, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody depends on my uncle for everything twice over again and somebody must depend on my uncle for everything in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 依靠（一般过去式 depended on my uncle for everything：1976 年工程师头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 依靠（一般现在 depends on my uncle for everything：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 依靠（不定式 to depend on my uncle for everything：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 依靠（过去完成时 had depended on my uncle for everything：1970 年四月的说明书上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 依靠（动名词 depending on my uncle for everything 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 取决于（depend on the weather alone：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去取决于全看天气）
G. v. 取决于（depend on the weather alone：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 依靠（后段两处：新来的工人照例 depends on the weather alone，而母亲又一次 depended on my uncle for everything）

answers.why: depend 意为“依靠”，1976 年工程师一言不发地依靠样样依靠我叔叔，那是车间里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 depended。
depend 意为“依靠”，自那以后工程师来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 depends。
depend 意为“依靠”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯依靠样样依靠我叔叔”，此处为不定式 to depend on my uncle for everything。
depend 意为“依靠”，说明书里 四月 那行字说明早在 1983 年之前就有人依靠过，故用过去完成时 had depended。
depend 意为“依靠”，工程师说“依靠样样依靠我叔叔这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 depending on my uncle for everything 作主语。
depend 意为“取决于”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去取决于全看天气”，should ever 之后用原形 depend on the weather alone。
depend 意为“取决于”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻取决于全看天气（depend on the weather alone at once），以后再也不要提起。
depend 意为“依靠”，新来的工人每个年头都照例取决于全看天气，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 depends。
depend 意为“依靠”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地依靠样样依靠我叔叔，用一般过去式 depended 叙述。
depend 意为“依靠”，结尾那句是母亲 1988 年的话：要依靠样样依靠我叔叔，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车间记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，工程师一言不发地依靠样样依靠我叔叔；车间里每一个工人都说这是头一回。（depended on my uncle for everything）
多年以后，工程师仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（depends on my uncle for everything）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯依靠样样依靠我叔叔这件事本身。（to depend on my uncle for everything）
早在 1970 年就有人依靠样样依靠我叔叔，四月那天说明书上的一行字就是证据。（had depended on my uncle for everything）
工程师说过，一言不发地依靠样样依靠我叔叔这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（depending on my uncle for everything 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻取决于全看天气，以后再也不要提起。（depend on the weather alone，祈使句）
answers: In 1976 the engineer depended on my uncle for everything in silence, and every worker in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the engineer still depends on my uncle for everything twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to depend on my uncle for everything at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had depended on my uncle for everything long before 1983, and the line in the manual for April proves it.
Depending on my uncle for everything in silence, the engineer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Depend on the weather alone at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 depend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the engineer depended on my uncle for everything in silence, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the engineer depends on my uncle for everything twice over whenever the workshop asks.
Depending on my uncle for everything in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever depend on the weather alone twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new worker from the next workshop depends on the weather alone in silence every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother depended on my uncle for everything again, and the workshop remembered that half.
